//
// We override the Bootstrap grid with a CSS grid so year + content align
// cleanly on a shared baseline.

.cv-section ul.list-group,
.cv-section ul.list-group-flush {
  list-style: none;

/*******************************************************************************
 * CV — Academic Editorial timeline.
 *
 * Sections render as <section class="cv-section"> with a serif title and a
 * hairline rule. Time-table entries use a CSS grid with a mono year gutter
 * on the left, institution/role/items on the right.
 ******************************************************************************/

// ------------ CV page header + PDF button ---------------------------------
.cv-pdf-button {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;

  i { margin-right: $sp-1; }
}

@media (max-width: 576px) {
  .cv-pdf-button {
    position: static;
    margin-top: $sp-3;
  }
}

// ------------ Section wrapper ---------------------------------------------
.cv-section {
  margin-top: $sp-7;
  margin-bottom: $sp-5;

  &:first-child { margin-top: $sp-5; }

  .cv-section__title {
    font-family: $ff-serif;
    font-size: $fs-xl;
    font-weight: $fw-semibold;
    color: var(--global-text-color);
    margin: 0 0 $sp-4;
    padding-bottom: $sp-3;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline);
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }
}

// ------------ Anchor (offset so #id scrolls below the fixed nav) ---------
a.anchor {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  top: -50px;
  visibility: hidden;
}

// ------------ Time-table entries ------------------------------------------
// Structure emitted by _includes/cv/time_table.liquid:
//   <ul.card-text.font-weight-light.list-group.list-group-flush>
//     <li.list-group-item>
//       <div.row>
//         <div.col-xs-2.cl-sm-2.col-md-2.text-center> ← year badge
//         <div.col-xs-10.cl-sm-10.col-md-10>        ← title / institution / items
//
// We override the Bootstrap grid with a CSS grid so year + content align
// cleanly on a shared baseline.

.cv-section ul.list-group,
.cv-section ul.list-group-flush {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  background: transparent;

  > li.list-group-item {
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline);
    padding: $sp-5 0;

    &:first-child { border-top: 0; }

    > .row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 12rem 1fr;
      gap: $sp-5;
      margin: 0;
      align-items: baseline;

      // Kill Bootstrap col-sm-* width; let grid handle layout.
      > [class*="col-"] {
        flex: none;
        max-width: none;
        width: auto;
        padding: 0;
      }
    }
  }
}

// Year column
.cv-section .table-cv {
  background: transparent !important;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;

  td { padding: 0; border: 0; }
}

// CV year badge — standalone class, no Bootstrap/MDB .badge hook in the
// markup so no external stylesheet can reach this element. All properties
// still carry !important as a safety net in case the .badge class is
// ever re-introduced on a descendant.
.cv-year-badge {
  display: inline-block !important;
  padding: $sp-1 $sp-2 !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  background-color: transparent !important;
  background-image: none !important;
  color: var(--global-theme-color) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--global-theme-color) !important;
  border-radius: $r-sm !important;
  font-family: $ff-mono !important;
  font-size: $fs-xs !important;
  font-weight: $fw-semibold !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

p.location {
  font-family: $ff-mono;
  font-size: $fs-xs;
  color: var(--mono-meta-color);
  white-space: nowrap;
  margin: $sp-1 0 0;

  i.iconlocation {
    color: var(--global-theme-color);
    font-size: 0.9em;
    margin-right: $sp-1;
  }
}

// Right column (title / institution / department / description)
.cv-section {
  h5.title {
    font-family: $ff-sans !important;
    font-size: $fs-md !important;
    font-weight: $fw-semibold !important;
    color: var(--global-text-color) !important;
    margin: 0 0 $sp-2 !important;
